# w.scrpt 0.1.0 RC25 checkpoint

Date: 2026-07-28

Worktree: `/path/to/wscrpt`

## Scope

RC25 adds bounded staged Git commit support so the editor can cover the common edit → stage → commit loop without leaving the keyboard-first IDE surface.

- `Esc v c` prompts for a commit message.
- `:commit`, `:commit-staged`, and `:git-commit` open the same prompt.
- Empty commit messages are refused before leaving the prompt.
- A commit requires at least one staged path.
- The commit runs `git commit --message <message>` directly, never through a shell.
- The message is passed as one literal argument, so shell-looking text remains commit text.
- The command commits only the already-staged index; it does not stage, save, push, pull, tag, reset, checkout, switch, or discard working-tree content.
- The existing bounded Git runner still supplies the five-second deadline, stdout/stderr retention limits, and process-group cleanup.
- Git summary is refreshed after a successful commit.
- The keymap reference, action footer, README, and iPad QA matrix expose the new commit route.

## Proof boundary

This checkpoint is locally verified on the host Rust/PTY path. It is not a real iPad Magic Keyboard, Blink Shell, mosh, SSH, tmux, clipboard, touch, reconnect, or real language-server proof. Those remain manual QA gates in `docs/IPAD_BLINK_QA.md`.
